altermagnetic_splitting_max.name: Maximum altermagnetic splitting

ar_uptake.name: Argon uptake

average_oxidation_states.name: Average oxidation states
average_oxidation_states.description: Text descriptor for average oxidation states, retained with its original source and method labels.

average_voltage.name: Average battery voltage

band_gap.name: Electronic band gap

band_gap_direct.name: Direct electronic band gap

battery_formula.name: Battery formula
battery_formula.description: Text descriptor for battery formula, retained with its original source and method labels.

birefringence.name: Birefringence
birefringence.description: Source-reported birefringence values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

born_effective_charge_max.name: Maximum Born effective charge
born_effective_charge_max.description: Source-reported maximum born effective charge values in e, retained separately for each source and method. This is a scalar maximum summary, not the complete Born effective-charge tensor.

bulk_modulus_eos.name: Bulk modulus from equation of state
bulk_modulus_eos.description: Source-reported bulk modulus from equation of state values in GPa, retained separately for each source and method. Retained under its own normalized key; do not assume equivalence with the separate eos_bulk_modulus table or identical fitting conventions.

bulk_modulus_pressure_derivative.name: Pressure derivative of bulk modulus
bulk_modulus_pressure_derivative.description: Source-reported pressure derivative of bulk modulus values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

bulk_modulus_reuss.name: Bulk modulus — Reuss
bulk_modulus_reuss.description: Source-reported bulk modulus — reuss values in GPa, retained separately for each source and method.

bulk_modulus_voigt.name: Bulk modulus — Voigt
bulk_modulus_voigt.description: Source-reported bulk modulus — voigt values in GPa, retained separately for each source and method.

bulk_modulus_vrh.name: Bulk modulus — Voigt–Reuss–Hill
bulk_modulus_vrh.description: Source-reported bulk modulus — voigt–reuss–hill values in GPa, retained separately for each source and method.

capacity_gravimetric.name: Gravimetric battery capacity
capacity_gravimetric.description: Source-reported gravimetric battery capacity values in mAh/g, retained separately for each source and method.

capacity_volumetric.name: Volumetric battery capacity
capacity_volumetric.description: Source-reported volumetric battery capacity values in mAh/cm³, retained separately for each source and method.

cbm.name: Conduction band minimum
cbm.description: Source-reported conduction band minimum values in eV, retained separately for each source and method.

chemical_name.name: Chemical name
chemical_name.description: Text descriptor for chemical name, retained with its original source and method labels.

co2_heat_of_adsorption.name: Carbon dioxide heat of adsorption

co2_n2_selectivity.name: Carbon dioxide / nitrogen selectivity

co2_uptake.name: Carbon dioxide uptake
co2_uptake.description: Source-reported carbon dioxide uptake values in mol/kg, retained separately for each source and method.

continuous_symmetry_measure.name: Continuous symmetry measure
continuous_symmetry_measure.description: Source-reported continuous symmetry measure values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

coordination_environments.name: Coordination environments
coordination_environments.description: Text descriptor for coordination environments, retained with its original source and method labels.

curie_temperature.name: Curie temperature
curie_temperature.description: Source-reported curie temperature values in K, retained separately for each source and method.

debye_temperature.name: Debye temperature
debye_temperature.description: Source-reported debye temperature values in K, retained separately for each source and method.

decomposes_to.name: Decomposition products
decomposes_to.description: Text descriptor for decomposition products, retained with its original source and method labels.

decomposition_energy.name: Decomposition energy
decomposition_energy.description: Source-reported decomposition energy values in eV/atom, retained separately for each source and method. The sign and reference decomposition depend on the source; do not automatically equate this field with energy_above_hull.

density.name: Mass density
density.description: Source-reported mass density values in g/cm³, retained separately for each source and method.

dielectric_constant_electronic.name: Electronic dielectric constant
dielectric_constant_electronic.description: Source-reported electronic dielectric constant values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

dielectric_constant_ionic.name: Ionic dielectric constant
dielectric_constant_ionic.description: Source-reported ionic dielectric constant values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

dielectric_constant_total.name: Total dielectric constant
dielectric_constant_total.description: Source-reported total dielectric constant values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

dimensionality.name: Structural dimensionality
dimensionality.description: Text descriptor for structural dimensionality, retained with its original source and method labels.

dos_at_fermi.name: Density of states at Fermi level
dos_at_fermi.description: Source-reported density of states at fermi level values in states/eV, retained separately for each source and method. The manifest unit is states/eV; normalization by cell, formula unit, spin, or atom must be checked upstream.

dynamically_stable.name: Dynamical stability flag
dynamically_stable.description: Source-reported 0/1 flag for dynamical stability; criteria depend on the upstream dataset.

easy_axis.name: Magnetic easy axis
easy_axis.description: Text descriptor for magnetic easy axis, retained with its original source and method labels. The manifest flags 1,521 values in an unexpected column for this property; inspect the actual Parquet schema and value placement before use.

effective_mass_electron.name: Electron effective mass
effective_mass_electron.description: Source-reported electron effective mass values in m_e, retained separately for each source and method. The table is a normalized effective-mass summary; directional, tensor, and extremum conventions depend on the source.

effective_mass_hole.name: Hole effective mass
effective_mass_hole.description: Source-reported hole effective mass values in m_e, retained separately for each source and method. The table is a normalized effective-mass summary; directional, tensor, and extremum conventions depend on the source.

elastic_anisotropy.name: Elastic anisotropy
elastic_anisotropy.description: Source-reported elastic anisotropy values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

electrode_stability_charged.name: Charged electrode stability
electrode_stability_charged.description: Source-reported charged electrode stability values in eV/atom, retained separately for each source and method.

electrode_stability_discharged.name: Discharged electrode stability
electrode_stability_discharged.description: Source-reported discharged electrode stability values in eV/atom, retained separately for each source and method.

electrode_volume_change.name: Electrode volume change
electrode_volume_change.description: Source-reported electrode volume change values in fraction, retained separately for each source and method.

electron_phonon_coupling.name: Electron–phonon coupling
electron_phonon_coupling.description: Source-reported electron–phonon coupling values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

elf_max.name: Maximum electron localization function
elf_max.description: Source-reported maximum electron localization function values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

energy_above_hull.name: Energy above convex hull
energy_above_hull.description: Source-reported energy above convex hull values in eV/atom, retained separately for each source and method. Computed hull references and competing phase sets differ among sources and methods; this is not a guarantee of physical stability.

energy_density_gravimetric.name: Gravimetric battery energy density
energy_density_gravimetric.description: Source-reported gravimetric battery energy density values in Wh/kg, retained separately for each source and method.

energy_density_volumetric.name: Volumetric battery energy density
energy_density_volumetric.description: Source-reported volumetric battery energy density values in Wh/L, retained separately for each source and method.

energy_per_t_atom.name: Energy per framework T atom
energy_per_t_atom.description: Source-reported energy per framework t atom values in kJ/mol, retained separately for each source and method. The source key denotes a framework T-atom energy and reports kJ/mol; the reference state and molar normalization require the Deem-zeolites source definition.

eos_bulk_modulus.name: Equation-of-state bulk modulus
eos_bulk_modulus.description: Source-reported equation-of-state bulk modulus values in GPa, retained separately for each source and method. Retained separately from bulk_modulus_eos; source fitting conventions and data populations can differ.

exfoliation_energy.name: Exfoliation energy
exfoliation_energy.description: Source-reported exfoliation energy values in meV/atom, retained separately for each source and method.

experimentally_observed.name: Experimentally observed flag
experimentally_observed.description: Source-reported 0/1 flag for experimentally observed; criteria depend on the upstream dataset. A source provenance flag indicates an experimental association, not validation of every property value in the aggregate.

fermi_energy.name: Fermi energy
fermi_energy.description: Source-reported fermi energy values in eV, retained separately for each source and method.

formation_energy_per_atom.name: Formation energy per atom
formation_energy_per_atom.description: Source-reported formation energy per atom values in eV/atom, retained separately for each source and method.

framework_bond_dissociation_energy.name: Framework bond dissociation energy
framework_bond_dissociation_energy.description: Source-reported framework bond dissociation energy values in eV/atom, retained separately for each source and method. The manifest uses eV/atom; inspect the FAIR-MOFs definition before interpreting it as an individual bond dissociation energy.

framework_density.name: Framework T-atom density
framework_density.description: Source-reported framework t-atom density values in T/1000 Å³, retained separately for each source and method. T denotes framework tetrahedral atoms; this number density differs from the mass-density table.

gllbsc_derivative_discontinuity.name: GLLB-SC derivative discontinuity
gllbsc_derivative_discontinuity.description: Source-reported gllb-sc derivative discontinuity values in eV, retained separately for each source and method.

grain_boundary_energy.name: Grain boundary energy
grain_boundary_energy.description: Source-reported grain boundary energy values in J/m², retained separately for each source and method.

grain_boundary_types.name: Grain boundary types
grain_boundary_types.description: Text descriptor for grain boundary types, retained with its original source and method labels.

h2_uptake.name: Hydrogen uptake
h2_uptake.description: Source-reported hydrogen uptake values in g/L, retained separately for each source and method.

hardness_vickers.name: Vickers hardness
hardness_vickers.description: Source-reported vickers hardness values in GPa, retained separately for each source and method.

has_imaginary_phonon.name: Imaginary phonon flag
has_imaginary_phonon.description: Source-reported 0/1 flag for imaginary phonon; criteria depend on the upstream dataset.

has_reconstructed_surface.name: Surface reconstruction flag
has_reconstructed_surface.description: Source-reported 0/1 flag for surface reconstruction; criteria depend on the upstream dataset.

heat_capacity.name: Heat capacity
heat_capacity.description: Source-reported heat capacity values in J/mol·K, retained separately for each source and method. The manifest does not establish constant-pressure versus constant-volume or the temperature; retain source and method conditions.

heat_of_formation.name: Heat of formation
heat_of_formation.description: Source-reported heat of formation values in eV/atom, retained separately for each source and method. Kept separate from formation_energy_per_atom; source reference states and thermodynamic conventions must be retained.

interlayer_binding_energy.name: Interlayer binding energy
interlayer_binding_energy.description: Source-reported interlayer binding energy values in meV/Å², retained separately for each source and method.

ionic_conductivity.name: Ionic conductivity
ionic_conductivity.description: Source-reported ionic conductivity values in S/cm, retained separately for each source and method. Conductivity depends on temperature and measurement or calculation conditions; the normalized table alone does not establish a room-temperature benchmark.

is_gap_direct.name: Direct band gap flag
is_gap_direct.description: Source-reported 0/1 flag for direct band gap; criteria depend on the upstream dataset.

is_metal.name: Metallicity flag
is_metal.description: Source-reported 0/1 flag for metallicity; criteria depend on the upstream dataset.

is_stable.name: Stability flag
is_stable.description: Source-reported 0/1 flag for stability; criteria depend on the upstream dataset. Retain the original source stability criterion; a Boolean classification does not establish dynamical, chemical, and experimental stability together.

largest_cavity_diameter.name: Largest cavity diameter
largest_cavity_diameter.description: Source-reported largest cavity diameter values in Å, retained separately for each source and method.

largest_free_path_diameter.name: Largest free path diameter
largest_free_path_diameter.description: Source-reported largest free path diameter values in Å, retained separately for each source and method. Keep the upstream geometric definition; do not merge automatically with pore_limiting_diameter despite related pore metrics.

lattice_thermal_conductivity.name: Lattice thermal conductivity
lattice_thermal_conductivity.description: Source-reported lattice thermal conductivity values in W/m·K, retained separately for each source and method. Temperature, tensor averaging, isotope treatment, and calculation conventions are source dependent.

lattice_thermal_conductivity_coherence.name: Lattice thermal conductivity — coherence contribution
lattice_thermal_conductivity_coherence.description: Source-reported lattice thermal conductivity — coherence contribution values in W/m·K, retained separately for each source and method. A source-defined coherence contribution; it is not necessarily interchangeable with a separately reported total lattice conductivity.

lattice_thermal_conductivity_particle.name: Lattice thermal conductivity — particle contribution
lattice_thermal_conductivity_particle.description: Source-reported lattice thermal conductivity — particle contribution values in W/m·K, retained separately for each source and method. A source-defined particle contribution; it is not necessarily interchangeable with a separately reported total lattice conductivity.

layer_group_number.name: Layer group number
layer_group_number.description: Source-reported layer group number values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

magnetic_anisotropy_constant.name: Magnetic anisotropy constant
magnetic_anisotropy_constant.description: Source-reported magnetic anisotropy constant values in MJ/m³, retained separately for each source and method.

magnetic_ordering.name: Magnetic ordering
magnetic_ordering.description: Text descriptor for magnetic ordering, retained with its original source and method labels.

magnetic_polarization.name: Magnetic polarization
magnetic_polarization.description: Source-reported magnetic polarization values in T, retained separately for each source and method.

magnetic_species.name: Magnetic species
magnetic_species.description: Text descriptor for magnetic species, retained with its original source and method labels.

magnetization_per_atom.name: Magnetization per atom
magnetization_per_atom.description: Source-reported magnetization per atom values in μB/atom, retained separately for each source and method.

magnetization_per_volume.name: Magnetization per volume
magnetization_per_volume.description: Source-reported magnetization per volume values in μB/Å³, retained separately for each source and method.

max_residual_force.name: Maximum residual force
max_residual_force.description: Source-reported maximum residual force values in eV/Å, retained separately for each source and method. This is a calculation-convergence diagnostic, not a force-field training dataset or a material-intrinsic property; maximum/component conventions require source inspection.

max_residual_stress.name: Maximum residual stress
max_residual_stress.description: Source-reported maximum residual stress values in eV/Å³, retained separately for each source and method. This is a calculation-convergence diagnostic; the manifest uses eV/Å³, and the residual norm/component convention requires source inspection.

max_voltage_step.name: Maximum battery voltage step
max_voltage_step.description: Source-reported maximum battery voltage step values in V, retained separately for each source and method.

measured_chemistry.name: Measured chemistry
measured_chemistry.description: Text descriptor for measured chemistry, retained with its original source and method labels.

measurement_pressure.name: Measurement pressure
measurement_pressure.description: Source-reported measurement pressure values in GPa, retained separately for each source and method.

measurement_temperature.name: Measurement temperature
measurement_temperature.description: Source-reported measurement temperature values in K, retained separately for each source and method.

migration_barrier.name: Ion migration barrier
migration_barrier.description: Source-reported ion migration barrier values in eV, retained separately for each source and method. Keep the original migrating species, pathway, and calculation or measurement conditions; the scalar energy alone does not specify ionic conductivity.

mineral_name.name: Mineral name
mineral_name.description: Text descriptor for mineral name, retained with its original source and method labels.

mohs_hardness.name: Mohs hardness
mohs_hardness.description: Source-reported mohs hardness values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

n2_heat_of_adsorption.name: Nitrogen heat of adsorption
n2_heat_of_adsorption.description: Source-reported nitrogen heat of adsorption values in kJ/mol, retained separately for each source and method.

n2_uptake.name: Nitrogen uptake
n2_uptake.description: Source-reported nitrogen uptake values in mol/kg, retained separately for each source and method.

nmr_efg_max.name: Maximum electric field gradient
nmr_efg_max.description: Source-reported maximum electric field gradient values in V/m², retained separately for each source and method. This is a maximum electric-field-gradient summary in V/m², not a complete EFG tensor, NMR spectrum, or chemical shift.

num_voltage_steps.name: Number of battery voltage steps
num_voltage_steps.description: Source-reported number of battery voltage steps values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

oxidation_states.name: Oxidation states
oxidation_states.description: Text descriptor for oxidation states, retained with its original source and method labels.

pearson_symbol.name: Pearson symbol
pearson_symbol.description: Text descriptor for pearson symbol, retained with its original source and method labels.

phonon_log_average_frequency.name: Logarithmic average phonon frequency
phonon_log_average_frequency.description: Source-reported logarithmic average phonon frequency values in K, retained separately for each source and method. Reported in kelvin as a frequency-equivalent temperature; do not interpret the values directly as THz.

phonon_max_frequency.name: Maximum phonon frequency
phonon_max_frequency.description: Source-reported maximum phonon frequency values in THz, retained separately for each source and method.

phonon_min_frequency.name: Minimum phonon frequency
phonon_min_frequency.description: Source-reported minimum phonon frequency values in THz, retained separately for each source and method.

piezoelectric_max_direction.name: Direction of maximum piezoelectric response
piezoelectric_max_direction.description: Text descriptor for direction of maximum piezoelectric response, retained with its original source and method labels.

piezoelectric_modulus.name: Piezoelectric modulus
piezoelectric_modulus.description: Source-reported piezoelectric modulus values in C/m², retained separately for each source and method. The manifest uses C/m², consistent with a piezoelectric stress coefficient; do not relabel it as a pC/N strain coefficient or assume a complete tensor.

poisson_ratio.name: Poisson ratio
poisson_ratio.description: Source-reported poisson ratio values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

pore_channel_count.name: Pore channel count
pore_channel_count.description: Source-reported pore channel count values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

pore_limiting_diameter.name: Pore limiting diameter
pore_limiting_diameter.description: Source-reported pore limiting diameter values in Å, retained separately for each source and method.

pore_volume.name: Pore volume
pore_volume.description: Source-reported pore volume values in cm³/g, retained separately for each source and method.

power_factor.name: Thermoelectric power factor
power_factor.description: Source-reported thermoelectric power factor values in μW/cm·K², retained separately for each source and method. Retain carrier concentration, doping sign, temperature, and transport assumptions; this is not the dimensionless thermoelectric figure of merit ZT.

predicted_synthesizable.name: Predicted synthesizability flag
predicted_synthesizable.description: Source-reported 0/1 flag for predicted synthesizability; criteria depend on the upstream dataset. This property-table entry is itself a prediction flag; its inclusion in properties/ does not make it an experimental synthesis outcome.

r_factor.name: Crystallographic R factor
r_factor.description: Source-reported crystallographic r factor values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization. This is a source-defined refinement agreement metric, distinct from structure_prediction_r_factor; verify scaling and refinement conventions upstream.

refractive_index.name: Refractive index
refractive_index.description: Source-reported refractive index values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

relative_energy_to_diamond.name: Energy relative to diamond
relative_energy_to_diamond.description: Source-reported energy relative to diamond values in eV/atom, retained separately for each source and method.

seebeck_coefficient.name: Seebeck coefficient
seebeck_coefficient.description: Source-reported seebeck coefficient values in μV/K, retained separately for each source and method. Retain carrier concentration, carrier type, temperature, and tensor or averaging conventions.

shear_modulus_reuss.name: Shear modulus — Reuss
shear_modulus_reuss.description: Source-reported shear modulus — reuss values in GPa, retained separately for each source and method.

shear_modulus_voigt.name: Shear modulus — Voigt
shear_modulus_voigt.description: Source-reported shear modulus — voigt values in GPa, retained separately for each source and method.

shear_modulus_vrh.name: Shear modulus — Voigt–Reuss–Hill
shear_modulus_vrh.description: Source-reported shear modulus — voigt–reuss–hill values in GPa, retained separately for each source and method.

shg_coefficient.name: Second-harmonic generation coefficient
shg_coefficient.description: Source-reported second-harmonic generation coefficient values in pm/V, retained separately for each source and method. A source-defined scalar second-harmonic generation coefficient in pm/V; tensor component, frequency, and convention require upstream inspection.

slme.name: Spectroscopic limited maximum efficiency
slme.description: Source-reported spectroscopic limited maximum efficiency values in %, retained separately for each source and method. A modeled photovoltaic efficiency metric reported in percent; it is not a measured device power-conversion efficiency.

sound_velocity_longitudinal.name: Longitudinal sound velocity
sound_velocity_longitudinal.description: Source-reported longitudinal sound velocity values in m/s, retained separately for each source and method.

sound_velocity_transverse.name: Transverse sound velocity
sound_velocity_transverse.description: Source-reported transverse sound velocity values in m/s, retained separately for each source and method.

spacegroup_number.name: Space group number
spacegroup_number.description: Source-reported space group number values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

spillage.name: Spin–orbit spillage
spillage.description: Source-reported spin–orbit spillage values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization. A spin–orbit wavefunction-overlap screening metric, not a direct topological invariant or proof of a topological phase.

structure_prediction_r_factor.name: Structure-prediction R factor
structure_prediction_r_factor.description: Source-reported structure-prediction r factor values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization. A source-defined structure-prediction metric, distinct from the crystallographic r_factor table; retain its original definition.

structure_prototype.name: Structure prototype
structure_prototype.description: Text descriptor for structure prototype, retained with its original source and method labels.

strukturbericht.name: Strukturbericht designation
strukturbericht.description: Text descriptor for strukturbericht designation, retained with its original source and method labels.

superconductor_class.name: Superconductor class
superconductor_class.description: Text descriptor for superconductor class, retained with its original source and method labels.

surface_anisotropy.name: Surface anisotropy
surface_anisotropy.description: Source-reported surface anisotropy values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

surface_area_gravimetric.name: Gravimetric surface area
surface_area_gravimetric.description: Source-reported gravimetric surface area values in m²/g, retained separately for each source and method.

surface_area_volumetric.name: Volumetric surface area
surface_area_volumetric.description: Source-reported volumetric surface area values in m²/cm³, retained separately for each source and method.

surface_energy.name: Surface energy
surface_energy.description: Source-reported surface energy values in J/m², retained separately for each source and method.

symmetry_indicators.name: Symmetry indicators
symmetry_indicators.description: Text descriptor for symmetry indicators, retained with its original source and method labels.

tc_superconducting.name: Superconducting critical temperature
tc_superconducting.description: Source-reported superconducting critical temperature values in K, retained separately for each source and method. The sources mix experimental associations and computed superconducting critical temperatures; retain source/method labels and do not pool them as equivalent measurements.

thermal_conductivity.name: Thermal conductivity
thermal_conductivity.description: Source-reported thermal conductivity values in W/m·K, retained separately for each source and method. The normalized name does not specify electronic versus lattice contributions, tensor averaging, or temperature; keep it separate from lattice_thermal_conductivity unless the AFLOW definition establishes equivalence.

thermal_expansion.name: Thermal expansion coefficient
thermal_expansion.description: Source-reported thermal expansion coefficient values in 1/K, retained separately for each source and method. The scalar 1/K unit alone does not specify linear versus volumetric expansion, temperature, or tensor convention.

topology_class.name: Topological class
topology_class.description: Text descriptor for topological class, retained with its original source and method labels.

topology_invariant.name: Topological invariant
topology_invariant.description: Text descriptor for topological invariant, retained with its original source and method labels.

total_energy_per_atom.name: Total energy per atom
total_energy_per_atom.description: Source-reported total energy per atom values in eV/atom, retained separately for each source and method. Absolute energies from different methods and pseudopotentials do not share a universal zero and should not be pooled without reference alignment.

total_magnetization.name: Total magnetization
total_magnetization.description: Source-reported total magnetization values in μB, retained separately for each source and method.

vbm.name: Valence band maximum

void_fraction.name: Void fraction
void_fraction.description: Source-reported void fraction values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

volume_per_atom.name: Volume per atom
volume_per_atom.description: Source-reported volume per atom values in Å³/atom, retained separately for each source and method.

work_function.name: Work function

work_of_separation.name: Work of separation
work_of_separation.description: Source-reported work of separation values in J/m², retained separately for each source and method.

working_capacity_temperature_swing.name: Temperature-swing working capacity
working_capacity_temperature_swing.description: Source-reported temperature-swing working capacity values in mol/kg, retained separately for each source and method.

working_capacity_vacuum_swing.name: Vacuum-swing working capacity
working_capacity_vacuum_swing.description: Source-reported vacuum-swing working capacity values in mol/kg, retained separately for each source and method.

working_ion.name: Working battery ion
working_ion.description: Text descriptor for working battery ion, retained with its original source and method labels.

wulff_shape_factor.name: Wulff shape factor
wulff_shape_factor.description: Source-reported wulff shape factor values; the manifest supplies no unit, so retain the upstream definition and normalization.

youngs_modulus.name: Young's modulus
youngs_modulus.description: Source-reported young's modulus values in GPa, retained separately for each source and method.
